info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Business Control By Param1-spec
info.description: The Business Control Retrieval API allows users to access specific business control information based on various parameters. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of data related to business units and accounting, enabling organizations to make informed financial decisions. Typically utilized by financial analysts and business managers, this API supports use cases that require detailed insights into accounting practices and business unit performance. By providing this information, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and strategic planning.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed accounting information for a specific business unit identified by its unique reference number. You can use this to gain insights into financial reporting, budget management, and performance analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve specific accounting information pertaining to the business unit identified by ACC-200045. Ensure that the request contains the necessary parameters to obtain accurate data.

200.description: The operation completed successfully and returned the requested data.

GetBusinessControlByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body as a string format for the accounting operations.

businessUnitId.description: The unique identifier for the business unit.

costCenter.description: The cost center associated with the business unit.

planningPeriod.description: The planning period for the budget and forecasts.

budget.description: The budget details for the business unit.

forecastVersion.description: The version of the forecast associated with the business unit.
